_how_to_fill: PLACEHOLDER coordinates - replace with your chosen junction before the demo.
Google Maps: right-click a spot -> click the lat,lon numbers to copy them.
centre            = middle of the T where the side road meets the main road
side_wait_point   = where the waiting (red) car stops on the side road, ~5-8 m back from the main road
near_traffic_from = a point ~200 m along the main road to your RIGHT when you sit at the side road facing the main road
(Malaysia drives on the left, so that is where the NEAR-lane traffic comes from)
Then run:  python spatial_engine.py   -> it checks the geometry and prints the lane bearings.
